title: Michael's Copper Axe
body:
"A suspiciously conductive copper axe..."

Michael's Copper Axe is an axe that has a reddish brown handle, along with a blade made of copper. It can be found in the Flowering Meadows during a quest given by Jenna.

Description

Michael's Copper Axe can be found in 8 different spawn locations within the meadows as soon as the quest for it is accepted, in which it will have no owner, allowing anyone to take it.

When there is a thunderstorm, the axe has a unique ability to summon lightning onto the player holding it out with a 33% chance of happening each time lightning forms. This ability comes in handy to change certain trees and rocks into materials like Electrified Trees and Electrified Rocks

Though, when this ability does occur, the axe has a 50% chance to tarnish because of the lightning it summons, meaning it will lose the ability to control where lightning strikes, and it will change the axe's appearance and name by renaming the axe to "Michael's Tarnished Axe", and turning the handle a pale brown and the blade into

a very dark brown color, meaning the player will need to find a new one to get the ability back. The axe will still be able to chop down trees normally in this condition.

Trivia

  • This Copper Axe belongs to Mike Miner aka Michael.
  • As of the Flowering Meadows Revamp update, the axe will now have a chance to spawn on one of 6 workbenches scattered throughout the upper-levels of the meadows.
